Game Overview

Galaxy Survivor: Last Stand is a adventure game built around quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Galaxy Survivor: Last Stand is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Galaxy Survivor: Last Stand?

Galaxy Survivor: Last Stand is a free adventure game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Galaxy Survivor: Last Stand free to play?

Yes, Galaxy Survivor: Last Stand is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
